sections.kicker: Prepared for Muhammed Nelvin by Atla · November 2026
sections.lead: We looked at your site and your Instagram the way a new customer would. Here is what stood out, in order of weight.
sections.thesis: The projects say brand strategist. The headline says three nouns.
sections.keep: The project list. Ten named clients, each with the exact work done, reads like proof.

sections.label: Front door
title: Three things people
meet first.
Three things

pins.what: The headline is three abstract nouns.
pins.why: Any strategy studio could sign this. It does not say what Muhammed believes or who he does it for.
pins.how: Replace the nouns with the one belief behind the ten projects.
pins.label: Your headline
pins.cost: Clients read three nouns and file him with every other consultant.

pins.quote: Brand Strategy • Verbal Identity • Brand Experience
pins.what: The same three service words repeat on three of ten rows.
pins.why: The repetition makes the rows look alike. A reader cannot see which project changed a business and which was routine.
pins.how: Pick the two or three projects that changed something and give each a single sentence on what.
pins.label: Your project list
pins.cost: The strongest client work sits at the same weight as the weakest.

pins.what: The footer holds the only line with a point of view.
pins.why: It says what he cares about and sits at the bottom in small type.
pins.how: Move this idea up to where the headline is.
pins.label: Your footer
pins.cost: The one sentence that sounds like him is the last thing anyone reads.

sections.intro: You asked for a look at Muhammed Nelvin. I spent some time on your site. Three things stood out, and all three point the same way.

sections.body: It is 20 minutes with me. We go through this page together, on Muhammed Nelvin's own screens, and you leave knowing what to change first.
sections.note: A few short questions first, then you pick a time. You can also just reply to the email.

reference: Pentagram, from another category. The partners' names are the brand, and each project explains itself.
